title: Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2610.00188v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies. To make the accuracy-memory trade-off explicit and user-controlled, we further introduce a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified targe

translated_title: 基于不确定性感知的强化学习控制自适应三维建图
translated_abstract: 基于体素的体积建图是三维重建的基础，然而固定分辨率的网格在本质上效率低下——在均匀区域浪费内存，在复杂区域丢失细节。现有的自适应方法（如MAP-ADAPT）通过基于几何信息和用户自定义的语义类别列表来改变分辨率，部分解决了这一问题，但这些启发式方法需要专家调参，缺乏对未见物体的泛化能力，且没有提供显式的内存使用控制机制。我们提出了一个自适应框架，基于语义熵（捕捉标签不确定性）以及几何曲率和纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索来细化体素，从而实现有原则的分辨率分配，而无需依赖语义分类体系。为了使精度与内存之间的权衡变得显式且可由用户控制，我们进一步引入了一个强化学习智能体，在用户指定的目标（内存预算）下学习体素细分策略。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用语义熵（标签不确定性）、几何曲率和纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索来自适应细化体素的建图框架，并通过强化学习智能体在用户指定的内存预算下学习体素细分策略，实现了显式可控的精度-内存权衡。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an adaptive 3D mapping framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, geometric curvature, and texture richness, employing a reinforcement learning agent to learn voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified memory budget for an explicit and controllable accuracy-memory trade-off.
